bootstrap.accuracy_mask: common valid predictions on the same-row complete triads or frozen endpoint labels
bootstrap.aggregation: pool outer-test folds within each seed; recompute paired contrast within each draw and seed; average the nine seed contrasts
bootstrap.ci: linear-interpolated 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of defined draws; conditional on fitted models
bootstrap.coherence_mask: all structures, invalid predictions counted as outside threshold
bootstrap.draws: sample connected groups uniformly with replacement; retain every sampled group's structure multiplicity
bootstrap.paired: one shared draw matrix for every model, policy, seed and metric
bootstrap.seed_spread: sample SD and range of the nine paired seed deltas on the original cohort
